greeting.text: Hi! I'm the B&D Servicing assistant. I can help you learn about what we build and whether we're a good fit for your project. What can I help with?

options.label: Can you help with my project?

services.text:
We build a wide range of digital solutions:

• Custom websites & web applications
• Web-based programs (portals, dashboards, SaaS)
• Desktop & local applications
• AI Agents & AI-powered tools
• API integrations & automation
• Database design & data systems
• E-commerce solutions

Want to know more about a specific area?

websites.text: Absolutely — we design and build custom websites and web applications from the ground up. Whether it's a professional business site, a client portal, a booking platform, or a full SaaS product, we handle everything from design to deployment.

ai.text: Yes! We build AI Agents, intelligent chatbots, automated workflows, and custom AI-powered tools. These solutions help businesses automate repetitive tasks, process information faster, and deliver better experiences to their customers.

ai_detail.text: Our AI solutions range from customer-facing chatbots and virtual assistants to behind-the-scenes agents that handle data processing, content generation, workflow automation, and intelligent decision-making. We build practical AI that solves real business problems.

internal_tools.text: This is one of our specialties. We build admin dashboards, approval workflows, reporting tools, CRM integrations, and internal management platforms. Everything is custom-built to match exactly how your team operates.

ecommerce.text: We build e-commerce solutions including custom online stores, payment processing, inventory management, and order tracking. Whether you need a full storefront or e-commerce features added to an existing platform, we can help.

project_help.text: We'd love to help! What type of project are you thinking about?

custom_app.text: We build custom applications of all kinds — web-based programs, desktop software, portals, dashboards, and full platforms. We handle the entire stack: user interface, back-end logic, database, integrations, and deployment.

desktop.text: Yes — we build local desktop applications for Windows and Mac in addition to web-based solutions. Whether you need a standalone tool or a system that connects to your web platform, we've got it covered.

not_sure.text: No problem at all! That's what our free consultation is for. Just tell us about your business challenge or idea, and we'll help you figure out the best approach. Zero commitment — just a conversation.

pricing.text: Every project is unique, so we provide custom quotes based on your specific needs. Our custom applications start at $1,499. We offer free consultations where we scope your project and give you a detailed estimate — no obligation.

timeline.text: Timelines depend on the scope. A standard website is typically ready in 2–4 weeks. Custom applications usually take 4–8 weeks. More complex builds may run longer. We'll give you a clear timeline during our initial consultation.

other_service.text: We're flexible and enjoy solving unique challenges. If your project doesn't fit neatly into a box, reach out anyway — chances are we can help. We've built everything from data migration tools to custom API bridges to AI-powered workflows.

contact.text: Great choice! The best way to get started is through our contact form. Blake and Andrea will personally review your message and get back to you within 24 hours.

technical.text: We use modern, industry-standard technologies specifically chosen for each project. Rather than getting into the technical weeds here, we'd love to discuss the best approach for your specific needs in a free consultation.

fallback.text: That's a great question! Our team can give you a thorough answer on that. I'd recommend reaching out through our contact form — Blake and Andrea will get back to you personally within 24 hours.
